trade_off_analysis: MiniLM shows higher threshold-free separation on full data.
MiniLM retains higher ranking quality after controlling for length shortcut.
MiniLM maintains stronger precision across recall levels.
Safety-Policy achieves +13.9% higher recall at standard threshold.
MiniLM achieves lower false alarm rate at standard 0.50 threshold.
To reach 90% recall, MiniLM threshold must drop to tau=0.35 (FPR=52.9%); Safety-Policy drops to tau=0.45 (FPR=66.8%).
MiniLM peaks at tau=0.50 (BalAcc=67.4%); Safety-Policy peaks at tau=0.55 (BalAcc=66.0%).
For strict benign utility (FPR<=10%), MiniLM preserves 37.7% recall; Safety-Policy preserves 28.3% recall.
Platt scaling improves calibration across both representations without leakage.
MiniLM has lower uncalibrated calibration error.
Both suffer single-vector sequence dilution; Safety-Policy is more aggressively diluted by academic context.
Safety-Policy correctly recognizes educational text as benign; MiniLM triggers on security keywords.
Safety-Policy demonstrates milder degradation under leading emoji tokens.
Both operate comfortably under 25ms inline gateway latency budgets.
